annotations.text:
PRINT SPEC — A4 portrait, 794 x 1123 px authored at 96 px/inch.
Export PDF from the toolbar, then send to the printer at 300 dpi with 3 mm bleed added by the print shop.

TO FILL BEFORE PRINTING: the [QR CODE] box in the footer — point it at flyby.gis-point.com or a booth-specific landing page so you can count scans.

ALTERNATE DIRECTIONS (low-fi sketches, not finished art).
B — Instrument panel: the measured numbers carry the whole page. Strongest across a busy hall, weakest at explaining what the product actually is; the dark flood also drinks ink.
C — Diagram-led: the mechanism is the hero. Best for an engineer who stops and reads, weakest as a three-second walk-past grab.
Say the word and I build either one out to the same finish as the A4 front.
